question: Har Ghar Tiranga movement was proposed in which year’s Independence Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Har Ghar Tiranga’ is a campaign under the aegis of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav to encourage people to bring the Tiranga home and to hoist it to mark the 75th year of India’s independence. 
 
• Bringing the flag home collectively as a nation in the 75th year of independence thus becomes symbolic of not only an act of personal connection to the Tiranga but also an embodiment of our commitment to nation-building.
 
• The idea behind the initiative is to invoke the feeling of patriotism in the hearts of the people and to promote awareness about the Indian National Flag.
 
• To mark this momentous occasion, People are encouraged to hoist the flag in Their homes from the 13th to the 15th of August 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav**

 
 
• **​Amrit Mahotsav honours our freedom fighters and the Indian liberation cause in the spirit of Jan-Bhagidari to celebrate 75 years** of independence and the glorious history of its people, culture, and achievements.
 
• The **Mahotsav is celebrated as a Jan-Utsav to commemorate India’s 75th year of freedom**.
 
• These pillars are intended to educate the next generation about the history and battle for freedom.
 
• The goal of the Mahotsav is to establish a vision for India in 2047. It would also motivate people to take action and accomplish their goal of an independent India.
 
• The festival will feature a variety of social and cultural activities, as well as presentations of technology and scientific advances.
 
• The Mahotsav will be celebrated as ‘Jan Utsav,’ or the festival of the people of India, in the spirit of ‘Jan Bhagidaris,’ which means that we are all participants and stakeholders in our country’s growth.
